verdict.rationale: Aleph is a commercial SaaS FP&A platform. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public repository, an open-source license, or source availability; the 'source of truth' mentions refer to data lineage, not code.
